regions.label: Loading gates
regions.notes: Gates and loading carpet under the station roof. The corral behind the gates is hidden by the roof edge in front of the camera, so a long queue shows as a full gate area only. 2026-02-14 12:45 frame. Panomax pixelates people here in coarse blocks: blur 6 finds 8 of about 12 at the gates (2: 0, 4: 7, 8: 4).
